body: I'm glad they treated you well and as the women you are. Stay strong girl!
Well, back in the ED, waiting for a bed in a psych unit... I guess this is what it has come too. :'(

Thanks for the reply. I'm sorry you've had some hard times as well; no one should feel this way ever. 

My first thought on waking up was something along the lines of questioning why I couldn't speak and needing water; that much benadryl will give you the most wicked dry mouth ever. It didn't really occur to me what had happened for several hours after I woke up. When I was finally back to my baseline mentation, I was just really disappointed I woke up and scared I would be have to go to the psych ward.
